paragraphs.text: Mystical Archive is a series of bonus sheets tied to Arcavios expansion sets that use a unique card frame . The frames, art, and flavor text of the cards represent the books found in the scholarly library of Strixhaven University . They are inspired by European illuminated manuscripts , depicting the first time a spell has ever been cast.
While every Secrets of Strixhaven Play Booster contains a Mystical Archive card, the odds of it being rare or mythic rare are drastically lower than they were in Strixhaven: School of Mages .
